description: This file defines the sock_addr union and associated inline functions and declarations for handling socket addresses with support for IPv4, IPv6, and Unix domain sockets. It provides functions for manipulating and querying socket address structures.

methods.name: int sock_addr_get_family(const sock_addr * saddr)
methods.description: Inline function to retrieve the address family from a sock_addr structure.

methods.name: sock_addr_get_port
methods.description: Function to retrieve the port number from a sock_addr structure.

methods.name: sock_addr_is_addr_wildcard
methods.description: Check if the address is a wildcard address.

methods.name: sock_addr_is_family_eq
methods.description: Compare if two sock_addr structures have the same address family.

methods.name: sock_addr_is_port_eq
methods.description: Compare if two sock_addr structures have the same port.

methods.name: sock_addr_is_addr_eq
methods.description: Check if two sock_addr structures' addresses are equal.

methods.name: sock_addr_is_addr_eq_bits
methods.description: Check if the bits of two addresses are equal up to a specified number of bits.

methods.name: sock_addr_set_port
methods.description: Set the port number in a sock_addr structure.

methods.name: sock_addr_assign
methods.description: Assign a socket address based on family, port, and address data.

methods.name: sock_addr_inet_pton
methods.description: Convert an IP address in presentation format to network format and assign to sock_addr.

methods.name: sock_addr_inet_ntop
methods.description: Convert a sock_addr structure to presentation format (string).

methods.name: sock_addr_inet_ntop_copy_buffer
methods.description: Copy string representation of sock_addr to a buffer.

methods.name: sock_addr_inet_ntop_append_buffer
methods.description: Append string representation of sock_addr to a buffer.

methods.name: sock_addr_stringify_append_buffer
methods.description: Append stringified sock_addr to a buffer.

methods.name: sock_addr_nameinfo_append_buffer
methods.description: Append socket address info to a buffer with name resolution.

methods.name: sock_addr_from_buffer_hints_numeric
methods.description: Create sock_addr from buffer hints with numeric address.

methods.name: sock_addr_from_str_hints
methods.description: Create sock_addr from string with hints.

methods.name: sock_addr_from_str_numeric
methods.description: Create sock_addr from string with numeric address.
